Configuration

Brewkit reads its settings from brewkit.toml in the project root. Every key is optional; the defaults suit a single roaster with one temperature probe. This page lists the keys and what they change.

The roaster table

The [roaster] table describes the machine. Brewkit uses the drum size to estimate how long a batch needs and warns when a batch is larger than the drum can take. 

[roaster]
name = "Garage drum"
drum_grams = 500
probe = "bean"

Keys

KeyDefaultMeaning
drum_grams250Largest batch in grams
probe"bean"Where the probe measures: bean or air

Run brewkit check after editing the file; it reports unknown keys and values out of range, so a typo never silently falls back to a default. See the command line page for all options of the check.
